clusters.headline: Global Leaders Conclude Discussions At The 49th ASEAN Summit Manila
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto received recognition from Donald Trump during the ASEAN-United States summit session.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi presented traditional Indian handicrafts and artworks to various regional and international leaders.

clusters.headline: Borneo FC Prepares For ASEAN Club Championship Clash In Group A
aiSummaryBullets: Borneo FC is scheduled to play Manila Digger in the second match of Group A within the ASEAN Club Championship tournament.
Head coach Sergio Farias stated he is confident in his team's ability to secure a victory during this upcoming fixture.

clusters.headline: President Trump Commences Asia Visit With Arrival In Philippines
aiSummaryBullets: President Donald Trump reached the Philippines to start a three-day tour of Asia.
The itinerary includes meetings with the Quad group and a summit on nuclear security.

clusters.headline: Protesters And Police Clash In Manila Ahead Of Upcoming Summit Event
aiSummaryBullets: Demonstrators gathered in Manila to conduct public protests.
Physical confrontations occurred between protesters and police forces.

clusters.headline: Prime Minister Narendra Modi Visits Historic Manila Gurudwara
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited the Gurudwara Khalsa Diwan in Manila during his attendance at the 49th ASEAN Summit.
The visit included prayers and participation from local dignitaries, including Senator Francis Joseph Escudero.

clusters.headline: Philippine President Urges Greater ASEAN Unity Amid Global Tension
aiSummaryBullets: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. requested closer collaboration among ASEAN member countries.
The call for unity comes as a response to various emerging geopolitical tensions.

clusters.headline: Philippines Wins The Inaugural Eurovision Song Contest Asia Title
aiSummaryBullets: The Philippines claimed victory at the inaugural Eurovision Song Contest Asia held in Bangkok.
Teenage performer Carmelle Collado won the title with a dance track dedicated to Filipino women.

clusters.headline: Thomas Markle Jr Identified As Person Of Interest In Abuse Inquiry
aiSummaryBullets: Thomas Markle Jr has been linked to a child sexual abuse inquiry.
Authorities have officially named him a person of interest.
